# SEC-005: Authorization is discoverable and invalid tokens are rejected

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | both eras, http | [2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#protected-resource-metadata-discovery-requirements](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/authorization-server-discovery#protected-resource-metadata-discovery-requirements) |

Sends a request with none of the --header values. If the server answers it, it requires no authorization and the check is skipped; pass your token with --header so the rest of the run can proceed. If it requires authorization: the answer MUST be 401 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization#error-handling), the server MUST implement OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) through resource_metadata in a Bearer WWW-Authenticate header or a well-known URI (path-inserted, then root), and the metadata MUST list at least one authorization server (and, per RFC 9728, the resource). A request with an invalid bearer token MUST also get 401 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization#token-handling). Metadata is fetched only from the server's own origin. Runs once per server.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain SEC-005`. To leave it out of a run, add `"SEC-005"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
